== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Blaster (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Blaster]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_esb_2pg_japanese/blaster_japanese_white_border/48866 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/71a9585f96c0470da8c59525870238e3/IMG_20230905_0013.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 16, 786, 1040)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4db5158bf3e6f90c6c01dda8cddaa935c2b6d9379eff452423f36538168c86a9</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
